briefing: Markets leaned risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.2% and S&P 500 +0.5%. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below our $500 buy threshold, so we held all 7 positions rather than forcing a new trade, letting existing profit targets and stop-losses do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Dry powder' means keeping cash uninvested and ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today our cash balance sat just below the $500 threshold for new buys, so we held rather than forcing a trade just to stay fully invested. Forcing trades to deploy small amounts of leftover cash often means settling for weaker setups instead of waiting for higher-conviction ones.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留現金不投資，等待真正強勁的機會出現時才動用。今日我們的現金餘額略低於500美元的新買入門檻，因此選擇持有現金而非勉強交易以求「滿倉」。為了消耗少量剩餘現金而勉強交易，往往意味著接受較弱的進場點，而非耐心等待更具信心的機會。

market_education.summary_en: NASDAQ outpaced the S&P 500 today, +1.2% versus +0.5%, suggesting growth and tech names were favored in a broad risk-on session. No specific headline catalysts were available in today's feed to pin the move to a single event. The pattern is consistent with continued rotation into higher-beta sectors rather than a defensive posture.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克指數上漲1.2%，領先標普500的0.5%漲幅，顯示科技及成長股在整體風險偏好升溫的氛圍下較受青睞。今日資料中並無具體新聞標題可作為此波動的明確觸發因素。此走勢與資金持續輪動至高波動性板塊的模式相符，而非防禦性操作。
